proposals.before: The Spring and Autumn of Han and Jin says Wei gave Shu palace women to generals without wives. Lady Li, an imperial lady of splendid deportment, said, "I cannot endure repeated humiliation."
proposals.after: The Spring and Autumn of Han and Jin says Wei gave Shu palace women to generals without wives. Lady Li, the Zhaoyi, said, "I cannot endure repeated humiliation."
proposals.reason: 昭儀 is a Han consort rank-title (Zhaoyi), not a description of 'splendid deportment'.
